stem: A swimming pool contains 1,850 liters of water. Hose A is turned on and adds water at a constant rate of 40 liters per minute. Ten minutes later, hose B is also turned on and adds water at a constant rate of 35 liters per minute. Both hoses then run until the pool contains 9,000 liters. How many minutes after hose A was turned on does the pool contain 9,000 liters?
solution: Let \(t\) be the minutes since hose A was turned on. Hose B has run for \(t - 10\) minutes.
verify:
t = symbols('t')
sol = solve(Eq(1850 + 40*t + 35*(t - 10), 9000), t)
assert sol == [100]
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == sol
